description: [MGN offline] Optionally configure a WSUS server, then install Windows updates by using AWS-InstallWindowsUpdates. Use on instances launched from the upgraded AMI in environments without internet access.

WsusServerUrl.description: (Optional) WSUS server URL, for example http://wsus.example.internal:8530. Leave empty if WSUS is already configured on the instance (for example, by Group Policy).

SeverityLevels.description: (Optional) MSRC severity levels passed to AWS-InstallWindowsUpdates.

AllowReboot.description: (Optional) Allow the instance to reboot if an update requires it.
